description: This file contains unit tests for the CalcInput class in the CalculatorEngine, verifying input handling, sign toggling, digit addition, decimal point management, exponent handling, backspace behavior, and conversion to rational numbers.

classes.name: CalcInputTest
classes.description: Unit test class for testing the CalcInput class functionalities in calculator engine.

methods.name: CommonSetup
methods.description: Initializes the CalcInput instance with decimal symbol '.' before each test.

methods.name: Cleanup
methods.description: Resets the CalcInput instance by clearing and setting decimal symbol to '.' after each test.

methods.name: Clear
methods.description: Tests the clear functionality of CalcInput, including input digit addition, sign toggling, exponent handling, and reset to zero.

methods.name: TryToggleSignZero
methods.description: Verifies toggling sign on zero input results in zero without negative zero.

methods.name: TryToggleSignExponent
methods.description: Tests toggling sign of the exponent part in scientific notation.

methods.name: TryToggleSignBase
methods.description: Tests toggling the sign of the base number.

methods.name: TryToggleSignBaseIntegerMode
methods.description: Verifies toggling sign in integer mode.

methods.name: TryToggleSignRollover
methods.description: Checks rollover behavior when toggling sign near integer limits.

methods.name: TryAddDigitLeadingZeroes
methods.description: Tests that leading zeros are ignored in the input.

methods.name: TryAddDigitMaxCount
methods.description: Verifies that adding digits respects maximum length constraints for base and exponent parts.

methods.name: TryAddDigitValues
methods.description: Tests input of digits beyond hexadecimal range to ensure acceptance.

methods.name: TryAddDigitRolloverBaseCheck
methods.description: Checks that rollover is only allowed for bases 8 and 10.

methods.name: TryAddDigitRolloverOctalByte
methods.description: Tests rollover behavior in octal byte mode.

methods.name: TryAddDigitRolloverOctalWord
methods.description: Tests rollover behavior in octal word mode.

methods.name: TryAddDigitRolloverOctalDword
methods.description: Tests rollover behavior in octal double word mode.

methods.name: TryAddDigitRolloverOctalQword
methods.description: Tests rollover behavior in octal quad word mode.

methods.name: TryAddDigitRolloverDecimal
methods.description: Verifies that adding digits in decimal respects maximum string length and sign constraints.

methods.name: TryAddDecimalPtEmpty
methods.description: Tests adding a decimal point to an empty input.

methods.name: TryAddDecimalPointTwice
methods.description: Ensures adding a decimal point twice fails.

methods.name: TryAddDecimalPointExponent
methods.description: Verifies that adding a decimal point after an exponent is not allowed.

methods.name: TryBeginExponentNoExponent
methods.description: Tests starting an exponent when none exists.

methods.name: TryBeginExponentWithExponent
methods.description: Ensures starting an exponent when one already exists fails.

methods.name: BackspaceZero
methods.description: Tests backspace behavior on zero input.

methods.name: BackspaceSingleChar
methods.description: Tests backspace on a single digit input.

methods.name: BackspaceMultiChar
methods.description: Tests backspace on multiple digits.

methods.name: BackspaceDecimal
methods.description: Tests backspace behavior when decimal point is present.

methods.name: BackspaceMultiCharDecimal
methods.description: Tests backspace with multiple digits and decimal point.

methods.name: BackspaceZeroDecimalWithoutPrefixZeros
methods.description: Tests backspace behavior with leading zeros and decimal point.

methods.name: SetDecimalSymbol
methods.description: Verifies changing the decimal symbol from '.' to ','.

methods.name: ToStringEmpty
methods.description: Checks string representation of an empty input.

methods.name: ToStringNegative
methods.description: Verifies string output for negative number.

methods.name: ToStringExponentBase10
methods.description: Checks string output for base 10 exponent notation.

methods.name: ToStringExponentBase8
methods.description: Checks string output for base 8 exponent notation.

methods.name: ToStringExponentNegative
methods.description: Verifies string output for negative exponent.

methods.name: ToStringExponentPositive
methods.description: Verifies string output for positive exponent.

methods.name: ToStringInteger
methods.description: Checks string output when number is an integer, hiding decimal.

methods.name: ToStringBaseTooLong
methods.description: Tests behavior when the base string exceeds maximum length.

methods.name: ToStringExponentTooLong
methods.description: Tests behavior when the exponent string exceeds maximum length.

methods.name: ToRational
methods.description: Verifies conversion of input to rational number representation.
